Compatibility.heading: Compatibility check
Compatibility.intro: Checked automatically from the parts' specifications.
Compatibility.cpuSocketMismatch: The {cpu} processor does not fit the {motherboard} motherboard socket.
Compatibility.ramTypeMismatch: {ram} memory is not supported by this {motherboard} motherboard.
Compatibility.ramSlotsExceeded: {modules} memory modules do not fit in {slots} slots.
Compatibility.ramCapacityExceeded: {gb} GB of memory exceeds the motherboard maximum of {maxGb} GB.
Compatibility.caseFormFactorUnsupported: This case does not support a {motherboard} motherboard (supports: {supported}).
Compatibility.gpuTooLong: The graphics card ({gpuMm} mm) is longer than the case allows ({maxMm} mm).
Compatibility.coolerSocketUnsupported: The CPU cooler does not support the {cpu} socket.
Compatibility.radiatorUnsupported: The case does not support a {radiatorMm} mm radiator.
Compatibility.coolerTooTall: The CPU cooler ({coolerMm} mm) is taller than the case allows ({maxMm} mm).
Compatibility.coolerUnderRated: The CPU cooler is rated for {ratingW} W, below the processor's {cpuW} W.
Compatibility.psuFormFactorUnsupported: The case does not support a {psu} power supply.
Compatibility.psuInsufficient: The {psuW} W power supply is below the estimated {estimatedW} W draw.
Compatibility.psuBelowRecommended: The {psuW} W power supply is below the recommended {recommendedW} W.
Compatibility.m2SlotsExceeded: {drives} M.2 drives do not fit in {slots} motherboard slots.
Compatibility.unknownSpec: Could not verify one check because the specification "{spec}" is missing.
